reviewSamples.text: Absolutely recommended, I came from Alabama to buy a truck and had him run through it before purchasing. He took the time and detailed everything with me and even got me in on a Saturday morning. Ended up not buying the truck thankfully due to his knowledge and help. Nice man and very helpful to me today.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Alberto Mosconi
reviewSamples.text: I had Geno work on my son's 2012 Mustang.  He responded to my early morning text message and we discussed the game plan.  Had him install a new alternator and serpentine belt.  He has the car finish by noon for my son to pick up.  All coordinated from south Florida.  Great communicator.  Thank you Sir.
